query: SELECT ms.name, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND mc.imageUrl != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_images, SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl IS NULL OR mc.imageUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_images FROM marvel_cards mc JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id GROUP BY ms.name;
